description: Golden repos for repo-skill-miner evaluation (P3). Each case: repo, expected candidate domains the two-phase mining (signals + semantic) must surface, and negatives that must NOT be proposed. Used for manual regression: rerun the mining workflow on these repos and check coverage.

cases.notes: THU multi-agent classroom platform; 23 course skills are the ground truth subset. Templates alone find <50% — semantic phase must read skills/ structure and templates/.
Self-referential case: these capabilities already exist as skills here — validates mining finds what we already know is skill-worthy.
Small repo, low signal density — validates the miner does not hallucinate candidates from noise (precision check).
